info.name: Otto AI Backend v2
info.description:
API collection for Otto AI Backend - AI-powered Revenue Intelligence Platform

**Authentication Modes:**
- **DEV Mode (APP_ENV=DEV)**: No JWT token required - all requests work without authentication. Leave clerk_jwt_token empty or remove Authorization headers. The backend will automatically use a mock user.
- **PROD Mode (APP_ENV=PROD)**: JWT token required - set clerk_jwt_token variable with a valid Clerk JWT token. All protected endpoints require authentication.

**Note:** Individual requests have auth configured, but in DEV mode the backend ignores it and uses mock authentication. You can remove auth from requests in DEV mode if preferred.

See README.md for detailed authentication setup instructions.

item.name: Ghost Mode

request.description:
Get current ghost mode status for the user.

Returns:
- company_ghost_mode_enabled: Whether the company has enabled ghost mode
- user_ghost_mode_active: Whether the user has enabled ghost mode
- effective_ghost_mode: True if both company and user settings are enabled

Toggle ghost mode for the current user.

When enabled, meeting recordings owned by this user will have their audio_url and transcript hidden from other users (including executives).

Note: Ghost mode can only be enabled if the company has allowed it.

Toggle ghost mode availability for the company (EXECUTIVE only).

When enabled, sales reps in this company can activate ghost mode to hide their meeting recordings from executives.
